listing.name: International Superstar Soccer 2000 — ISS2000 (djultra64)
listing.summary: An early native port of the European International Superstar Soccer 2000 release with portable Windows and Linux setup packages.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Europe English/German revision 0 ROM, SHA-256 6ce6739b8ead149857c9442178a1ecd9b7f6d15b93a582c7208ca85d493817bf.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the complete ZIP into a writable folder. Run iss2000.exe on Windows or launch.sh on Linux, then select the supported original in the upstream picker. Use a Vulkan-capable GPU. The Linux package requires GLIBC 2.38 and GLIBCXX 3.4.32 or newer.

warnings: Upstream’s Windows smoke test reached the title screen, but the normal window-close request did not finish. Use the upstream setup route. Portcove has not observed normal exit, gameplay or save recovery.

references.title: Keep your original and saves
references.instruction: The upstream player keeps its imported original, settings and saves under data/ beside the executable. Keep your original separately and back up the data folder before replacing the package.
